verdict.rationale: Next.js is a React web framework, not an agent or tool-using host, so consuming MCP servers' tools is a category error for this product type. The only MCP evidence (next-js-docs-17) describes a built-in MCP endpoint that serves coding agents. That is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
